dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: Of course. After chasing the monsters away, I have absolutely nothing to do.

dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: Earlier, the young master asked me to help him pick some flowers, but he and that young lady started getting all lovey-dovey right away...

dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: What need do they have for flowers? I reckon the young master's forgotten all about it already.

dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: Do you want them? Just take them if you do. They're no use to me, anyhow.
